meta.description: Use Geniml for audited local genomic-interval workflows: validate BED and universe contracts, plan Region2Vec or scEmbed runs, inspect model/tokenizer compatibility, and assess consensus universes.

scientific_integrity.detail: Accurate representation of Geniml capabilities with explicit coordinate convention (0-based half-open), assembly contracts, and migration warnings for API changes

practice_boundaries.detail: Appropriate scope for genomic interval ML with clear boundaries: validators plan but don't rewrite, separates train/validation/test by biological unit, and treats BEDspace as legacy

methodological_ground.detail: Based on established genomic interval representations (BED format, Region2Vec/scEmbed embeddings) with proper coordinate system documentation

code_usability.detail: All code examples are syntactically correct with proper imports and safety boundaries

functional_suitability.note: Comprehensive coverage including BED validation, Region2Vec, scEmbed, consensus universes, tokenizer/model compatibility, with excellent reference organization and bundled audit scripts

reliability.note: Excellent reliability with 7-point safety gate, bounded validation planners, coordinate system validation, assembly contract enforcement, and migration notes for API drift

performance_context.note: Well-organized documentation (310 lines) with API map, migration notes, 5 comprehensive reference files, and bundled audit/planning scripts

agent_usability.note: Exceptional with explicit safety gate (7 rules), coordinate/assembly contract section, API migration notes, model compatibility checklist, and clear reference navigation

human_usability.note: Clear installation with lockfile guidance; reproducible pinning (geniml 0.8.4, gtars 0.9.2); bundled validators/planners; BEDbase cache management

security.note: Outstanding security: safety gate rejecting URLs/FIFOs/symlinks, explicit approval for downloads, model artifacts as untrusted (weights_only=True), sensitive data redaction, aggregate logs, bounded execution

maintainability.note: Excellent structure with version 1.1, clear licenses (skill MIT, Geniml BSD-2-Clause), 5 comprehensive references, version baseline (0.8.4 verified 2026-07-23), upstream version tracking

agent_specific.note: Strong composability with allowed-tools including Glob; bundled audit/planning scripts; dependency-free validators; minor: model artifact schemas not fully detailed

inputs.label: BED validation with assembly contract enforcement
inputs.note: Coordinate system validation and assembly checking

assertions.note: Coordinate/assembly contract section shows bed_validator.py with --assembly and --chrom-sizes
Coordinate contract explicitly states '[start, end): start is included, end is excluded'
Contract lists assembly/patch, contig naming, coordinate convention, liftover details
Contract states 'Reject negative coordinates, end <= start...Sorting and normalization never repair an assembly mismatch'
Validator 'reports proposed actions but never rewrites the BED file'

inputs.label: Region2Vec training with tokenizer and dataset

assertions.note: API map shows concrete import path: 'from geniml.region2vec.main import Region2VecExModel'

assertions.text: Tokenizer from Gtars with universe BED
assertions.note: Example shows 'Tokenizer.from_bed("refs/universe.bed")'
API map demonstrates 'Region2VecDataset("work/tokens.parquet", shuffle=True)'
Example shows model.train(dataset, epochs=10, window_size=5, num_cpus=4, seed=42)
Migration notes warn '0.8.4 wheel...do not re-export their modern classes/functions. Use the concrete module paths'
API map states 'Import ScEmbed from geniml.scembed.main'
scEmbed section states 'AnnData .var must contain chr, start, and end'
Section recommends 'Pre-tokenize to a Parquet tokens column and use the same Tokenizer'
API map directs to 'references/scembed.md' for details

assertions.text: CLI no-op warning for geniml scembed
assertions.note: Migration notes warn 'geniml scembed...command body is a no-op in 0.8.4' but not in main API section

inputs.label: Model artifact compatibility inspection with security

assertions.note: Model compatibility section shows model_artifact_inspector.py usage
Model compatibility section lists 5-item agreement requirements
Section states '.pt, Gensim .model, pickle, joblib...remain untrusted inputs' with weights_only=True loader
Guidance: 'Inspect and checksum artifacts before loading; use an isolated environment and never load a checkpoint merely to discover its metadata'
Gtars 0.9.2 adds seven special tokens mentioned but special-token ID preservation not detailed in compatibility section

inputs.label: Corpus auditing with leakage detection and manifest validation

assertions.note: Local audit CLIs section demonstrates corpus_auditor.py with manifest parameters

assertions.text: Group/split column specification for leakage detection
assertions.note: Example shows --group-column patient_id --split-column split for train/test contamination
Local audit section states 'All scripts are standard-library-only and default to redacted JSON'
Safety gate point 4 requires separation 'by patient, donor, biological replicate' but not demonstrated in audit example
Safety gate warns 'BED filenames, sample IDs, phenotypes, labels, barcodes...may be sensitive' but audit output content not specified

key_strengths: Exceptional security posture with comprehensive safety gate (7 rules), untrusted artifact policy (weights_only=True), explicit download approval requirements, and sensitive data redaction
Outstanding coordinate system discipline with explicit 0-based half-open BED convention, assembly contract requirements, and validation without silent repair
Excellent version transparency with API migration notes documenting module path changes, CLI drift, deprecated config keys, and package re-export removal
Strong reproducibility culture with lockfile guidance, PyPI artifact digest recording, Python/OS tracking, and checksum verification for models/universes
Comprehensive bundled tooling with dependency-free validators/planners that audit without executing Geniml or ML libraries

recommendations.title: Document audit output content for sensitive data review
recommendations.problem: Redacted JSON output mentioned but what remains in audit output not specified
recommendations.root_cause: Safety gate warns about sensitive data but audit script output format not detailed
recommendations.fix: Add to corpus_auditor.py description: 'Outputs file count, checksum mismatches, assembly conflicts, and split overlap warnings; excludes BED filenames, sample IDs, and phenotype values unless --reveal-paths specified'

recommendations.title: Add special-token ID preservation to compatibility checklist
recommendations.problem: Seven special tokens mentioned but not in compatibility agreement list
recommendations.root_cause: Gtars 0.9.2 behavior noted separately from model compatibility requirements
recommendations.fix: Add to compatibility checklist: 'Special-token IDs and vocabulary order (gtars 0.9.2 adds 7 special tokens to BED universe, changing tokenizer.len())'

recommendations.title: Highlight CLI no-op warnings in main API sections
recommendations.problem: geniml scembed CLI no-op buried in migration notes
recommendations.root_cause: Critical migration warning separated from API map where CLI might be referenced
recommendations.fix: Add warning to scEmbed API section: 'Note: geniml scembed CLI is a no-op in 0.8.4; use geniml.scembed.main.ScEmbed class instead'
